title: Dort, the recent Thomists and the Jansenists agree
source_text: LXXII. Nec minus quoque manifestum fecimus illos qui Synodo Dordracenae subscribunt, cum Thomistis recentioribus, & cum illis etiam qui Jansenio adhaerent idem, quoad rei summam, sentire & docere, circa doctrinam de gratia efficaci & sufficienti; & si quibus in rebus dissentire videantur, contentionem vel esse verbalem, vel non admodum momentosam.
pass_a_gloss: LXXII. No less also have we made it plain that those who subscribe to the Synod of Dort, with the more recent Thomists, & with those also who adhere to Jansenius, think & teach the same, as to the substance of the matter, concerning the doctrine of efficacious & sufficient grace; & if they seem to disagree in some things, the dispute is either verbal, or not of much moment.
pass_b_english: Thesis LXXII. We have shown just as clearly that those who subscribe to the Synod of Dort think and teach in substance the same thing on efficacious and sufficient grace as the more recent Thomists and the followers of Jansenius.
Where they seem to disagree on some points, the dispute is either about words or of little weight.
